# Monthly IC Memo — 2026-09

Session SESSION_MONTHLY_IC · 2026-09-05 · Aldrich (JUDGE), for the IC
Scope: first monthly IC. The packet aggregates inception-to-date (fund start 2026-07-11), so this memo reviews the full record, not a one-month slice.

sections.heading: Posture
sections.markdown: Both books remain fully in cash for a second consecutive month. GLOBAL and INDO each report **cash 100.0%, deployment 0.0%**, governor **NONE**, max drawdown **0.0%**, no open theses, no orders, no fills. The fund has run its full gauntlet for roughly two months and has yet to deploy a single dollar or rupiah. That is the central fact of this memo: the pipeline is, today, a zero-throughput filter.

sections.heading: Returns vs benchmark
sections.markdown: Not applicable in the ordinary sense — with no positions there is no portfolio return to attribute and the attribution/factor/sector blocks are empty. Book performance is cash-yield accrual only, and the IC reads "returns" this month as the **opportunity cost of the cash posture**, not a realized number. The more decision-useful evidence is in the kill ledger below.

**Reason mix:** valuation 9, other 7, process 6, liquidity 1, fragile_estimates 1.

### What worked

- **No bad capital deployed.** Twenty-four consecutive KILLs through the full gauntlet, zero tickets, zero losses. The fund has never made a losing investment because it has never made one — and the discipline has been real, not decorative: the same names killed twice on fresh passes (TXN, SMFG, ELSA, DSNG) show re-drafting does not launder a bad idea.
- **The valuation kills of over-priced US quality were the right tail.** TXN killed at 311 (07-13) and re-killed at 272 (08-19) is the single best-timed decision in the ledger — two separate rounds, ~22% cumulative avoided loss. The fragile-estimates kill (KLBF) and the liquidity veto (DSNG-002, deterministic ADV veto) show the pre-trade gates catching the correct failure classes.

### What didn't

- **Zero throughput.** 0 PASS, 0 tickets across two months and 24 kills. A filter that never passes nothing filters: the fund is now running a research exercise in which the deployment decision is never reached. This is the IC's #1 issue, ahead of any single kill.
- **Systematic early/cheap exits on IDX commodity-linked agri.** The four scored misses of 20–39% (DSNG ×2, LSIP, TAPG) plus ELSA +14.1 all sit in the same place: IDX agri/commodity names killed on valuation, process, or liquidity while the commodity/energy complex re-rated behind them. The framework was directionally right to reject over-priced US quality and mis-priced banks, but it has a blind spot for names whose re-rating is driven by the commodity complex rather than the name's own P&L — precisely the register the macro desk flags as bid (war premium intact, Brent ~95.9). Three independent cases meet the ≥2-case bar for a method-card review (VAL_COMMODITY_CYCLICAL treatment of agri) — routed to consolidation.
- **The PASS lane is untested.** 0700HK remains the sole judged name in fund history, PASS_REDUCED sized to zero and never ticketed. No PM has ever sized a live winner, so the script→PM deviation lane and winner-management machinery have never been exercised.

sections.heading: Next-month posture
sections.markdown:
1. **Deployment is the objective.** Point CONSTRUCT/WEEKLY_DEEP at converting the ADVANCE/WATCH queue into initial positions wherever the gauntlet honestly passes; re-examine whether the standing hurdle sits above the register of real opportunity in this tape. Not-trading remains a legitimate decision — but it must be a *decision*, not the default output of a filter with no throughput target.
2. **IDX commodity/agri valuation review.** Commission the method-card patch against the DSNG/LSIP/TAPG counterfactuals so the next commodity-linked IDX name is valued with the commodity/energy complex inside the frame, not outside it.
3. **Keep the teeth that work:** repeat-kill discipline, fragile-estimates gate, liquidity veto.
4. **Resolve 0700HK** — either define a concrete re-entry for the reduced position or close the file.
5. Fees verification is current (last verified 2026-07-06, 12-month cycle, not due). No action.
